title: Von Braun captured in Bavaria under Operation Paperclip
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Von Braun captured in Bavaria under Operation Paperclip, about 1945 at Bavaria, Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He was captured in Bavaria, where a young Henry Kissinger was actually helping run counterintelligence for the United States. von Braun's record was scrubbed,

plain: Operation Paperclip was the US programme that brought German scientists to America after the Second World War, and Wernher von Braun was a German rocket engineer who later helped build NASA's rockets. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says von Braun was captured in Bavaria, in southern Germany, in 1945, where a young Henry Kissinger, later a top US statesman, was helping run American counterintelligence. Michels says von Braun's record was then scrubbed, meaning his wartime past with the Nazi regime was cleaned up so he could work for the US.
